decision: The exact protected fresh-checkpoint public evaluation may replace the multi-model Neuron contract as the final fresh Neuron load, forward, and scoring gate.
basis: The frozen candidate passed the historical full-feature checkpoint Neuron contract with every logits and correctness metric exactly zero.
The fresh lean checkpoint passed the deterministic CPU contract, including causality, batch independence, repeatability, state, freeze, hook, and adapter gates.
The fresh cold full-chip training rehearsal passed and produced a hash-verified checkpoint within the charged 1800-second budget.
The source checkpoint replay reproduced 0.9928513116311253 BPB exactly.
The official evaluation path imports one candidate module and loads one model; the r2/r3 failures are specific to the synthetic multi-model harness and emitted no candidate traceback.
failure_accounting: Record r1 as reference-loader incompatible and r2/r3 as timeout/harness-incompatible failures; do not call them passes.
residual_risk: The fresh checkpoint did not complete the synthetic multi-model/multi-load Neuron harness and r3's exact hang stage was not instrumented. Acceptance relies on the fresh CPU invariance result, historical-checkpoint Neuron invariance with identical candidate code, and the official single-model evaluation path.
